items.title: What Does Gilead Sciences (GILD) Gain From Its Expanded EU Breast Cancer Approval?
items.summary: Gilead Sciences (NasdaqGS:GILD) received expanded European Commission approval for Trodelvy in combination with Keytruda as a first-line treatment for metastatic triple-negative breast cancer across PD-L1 status in Europe. The decision establishes Trodelvy plus Keytruda as the first antibody-drug conjugate and immunotherapy combination approved for first-line metastatic TNBC across the European Union.
